config.fontSize.description: Base editor font size, in pixels.
config.imageDefaultDir.description: Default directory for saving images. Leave empty to use the Markdown file's directory. Supports absolute paths (e.g. /path/to/dir) and relative paths (e.g. ./images or images/).
config.forceRelativeImagePath.descriptio: Always insert relative image paths in Markdown, even when imageDefaultDir is an absolute path.
config.language.description: Language for the editor interface. 'default' follows VS Code's display language. Settings descriptions always follow VS Code's display language.
config.toolbarMode.simple: Show undo, redo, and utility buttons. Use Cmd+/ (macOS) or Ctrl+/ (Windows/Linux) for other actions.
config.outlineStateScope.description: Controls whether outline visibility is remembered per file or shared globally.
config.outlineStateScope.file: Remember outline visibility separately for each Markdown file in the current workspace.
config.outlineStateScope.global: Use the last outline visibility for every Markdown file and across workspaces.
config.outlineDefaultOpen.description: Whether the outline starts open when no remembered visibility exists.
config.enableDebugLogging.description: Enable editor debug logging for troubleshooting.
